verdict.rationale: Gmail's first-party docs describe in-product Gemini features that work on the user's own mail: summarizing long threads into bullet points, drafting and refining emails, and acting on organization requests. Gmail also offers suggested replies 'in your voice'. Together these deliver AI suggestions and digest-style insights from the user's data. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or cross-mailbox insights beyond per-thread summaries, deeper documentation of how the features work and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
